supersedes: The empty-enabled-address rejection policy in wps-preflight-review-20261105.json is superseded by explicit user authorization for automatic random source generation.
behavior: Enabling spoofing in the advanced dialog fills an empty address immediately; old enabled-empty settings are filled on dialog load.
Clearing the enabled address and confirming generates another address. Explicit nonempty invalid addresses are still rejected before interface allocation.
The page, service, backend and direct executor share prepare_wps_options. A missing source is resolved once and passed forward; one batch keeps the same source across all targets and phases.
Disabled spoofing never generates or passes a source override. Valid manual addresses are preserved.
The dialog saves generated addresses through the existing save flow; reopening retains them. Quick-start fallback resolves only a task copy, without rewriting stored settings.
Generation uses six OS-random bytes with the multicast bit cleared and locally-administered bit set. No cache, timer, router MAC rotation, driver setting, or new package dependency is added.

compatibility.applicability: Applies because source-address input to the existing Reaver -m option changes. No new router command, radio ownership decision, or wireless configuration write is introduced.
compatibility.version_evidence: Inspected upstream Reaver v1.6.5 and v1.6.6 argsparser.c; these match the reaver version families listed in docs/offline-packages/support.json. Both parse -m through str2mac and set_mac.
compatibility.hardware_scope: MAC generation is local and independent of OpenWrt release, CPU architecture or target. Actual wireless transmission remains conditional on the existing Reaver/monitor/driver capabilities. Source inspection is not model-specific runtime acceptance.

sources.finding: -m parses a source MAC with str2mac and set_mac.

eth_random_addr clears the multicast bit and sets the locally administered bit.

verification.render_review: Generated address readable in both themes; existing controls and layout retained.

limits: No live router or RF test.
